text:
linda (PeopleOps): quick idea  can we make a 1-sided "onboard quickcard" managers can paste after offer accept? minimal, actionable.
cecil (Hiring Manager): yes. one that answers: who to ping, day1 agenda, and a tiny week1 deliverable.
maya (Mentor): include pairing plan: 3 x 1h sessions in week1. helps speed ramp.
emma (IT): manager needs to send full name + shipping address + laptop choice 48h before start. add `/device-request @it` command snippet.
linda (PeopleOps): draft below (copyable). keep it <1 page.
---
Preboard (before Day 1): manager: confirm shipping + laptop; add to #product + team channel; PeopleOps: send welcome email + 1:1 stub; IT: provision SSO
Day1 (sample): 9:30 manager intro (30m); 10:15 team intros (30m); 11:15 accounts check (15m); 1pm product overview (45m); 3pm pairing (60m)
Week1 goals: daily 30m check-in (first 3 days); 3 pairing sessions; shadow cross-functional meetings; finish a small onboarding task (first PR or notes)
Manager checklist: confirm device by Fri EOD; nominate buddy; set Top 3 onboarding goals; schedule weekly 1:1s + 30/60/90 review slots
30/60/90 bullets: 30d learn & connect; 60d contribute; 90d lead & scale
---
cecil (Hiring Manager): looks great. I'll paste into offer follow-up.
people-ops-bot: task created "Onboard quickcard" assigned to linda and emma, due in 48h.
